 * €65.000-€80.000 OTE (base + uncapped commission)

Build a career where your work truly matters. At Raiffeisen Bank International, with more than 17 million customers across Austria and CEE, it's our people who make the difference. 1 Junior ICE Limit Manager (f/m/x) 

2-Year Fixed-Term Contract

Join the "Limit Management & Business Risk" team, responsible for overseeing RBI's group-wide limit management for CIB Clients. Our primary objective is to maximize limit utilization efficiency by providing up-to-date limit reporting at both the Group Level and individual Client level. In addition, we play a vital role in ensuring the seamless processing of new business requests. As a team, we maintain a neutral and collaborative stance, acting as trusted partners to all IC business stakeholders, including Relationship Management, Capital Markets, Treasury, and Risk Management.   

 

 

Your mission:

 

 * Be part of a competence center directly interacting with Account Managers/Risk Managers/Product departments and all RBI Group Risk Takers (Head Office, Network Units, Subsidiaries).

 * Perform yearly risk limit reviews for the CIB Portfolio

 * Process ad-hoc increases/decreases of Capital Markets & commercial Limits, total Risk limits and Product CAPs.

 * Preparing and analyzing limit and exposure reports.

 * Supporting & participating in internal projects to increase process efficiency e.g. new limit management system, new reporting tools.

 

 

Your core competencies:

 

 * Bachelor's degree in business administration or similar, plus initial professional experience in banking or finance

 * Ideally first working experience in IC Business or IC Risk Area

 * IT affinity, critical & analytical thinking skills

 * Team player with an independent, well-structured, and goal-oriented working style

 * Proactive personality and ability to reinvent yourself 

 

 

What's in it for you:

 

 * Global community: 75+ nationalities, English as the company language, and work permit support. 

 * Career growth: We believe in continuous learning and proactive career development. Take on challenging work that stretches your abilities, attend trainings, and use new technologies to make a lasting impact.

 * Stay healthy: Subsidized canteen, well-being programs, check-ups, and sport allowances.

 * Save money: Discounts, exclusive banking terms, and a heavily subsidized public transport pass.

 * Family support: Child allowances, gender-neutral parental leave, bilingual company kindergarten, and holiday childcare.

 * Competitive salary: In accordance with Austrian legal requirements, the minimum salary for this position is EUR 2981,98 gross per month under the applicable Banking Collective Agreement. The actual salary is typically higher and will be determined individually based on your qualifications, professional experience, and the specific requirements of the role.
